algorithm: x-jam-call = '$' + lowercase-hex SHA1(path + nonce) + '*' + nonce + '~'. The hash input is the plain ASCII concatenation of the request path and the nonce, without the query string; the nonce echoed inside the header must byte-match the nonce that went into the hash (voicefox/source/src/jamendo/mod.rs:66-70 signs the path at :98 and again for /api/tracks at :243).

source_constants.note: Pins the fixed request headers against drift. x-jam-version '4gvfvv' appears exactly once in the whole upstream tree (mod.rs:27) with no documented origin; it is pinned as-is, not explained.
source_constants.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/143.0 Safari/537.36

cases.note: The /api/search + '0.5' vector is the upstream inline test assertion (mod.rs:513-525), i.e. hex(SHA1('/api/search0.5')); it was accepted by the live server (HTTP 200, 2026-11-18).

Three-decimal nonce shape as musid-dli's nanosecond generator emits it; recomputed with sha1 and accepted by the live server (HTTP 200, 2026-11-18). The server accepts hand-made nonces ('0.5', '0.253' both verified).
Batch track path: still signed with the bare path, no query string.
Album container path with a non-float nonce: any nonce string works as long as the echoed header matches the hashed input.
